task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

axes.name: answer_length
axes.description: 답변의 길이, 즉 문장 수와 단어 수의 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write a very brief summary using one or two short sentences.
Write a summary of about two sentences with moderate length.
Write a detailed summary using multiple sentences and more words.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 구조의 복잡성 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use short and simple sentences with straightforward structure.
Use sentences of moderate length with some complexity.
Use long and complex sentences with multiple clauses.

axes.name: hedging_level
axes.description: 확실성 표현(모호하거나 조심스러운 어조)의 사용 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Write statements confidently with minimal hedging or uncertainty.
Include hedging expressions to indicate uncertainty or caution.

axes.name: numerical_detail
axes.description: 숫자나 구체적 수치 정보의 포함 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Avoid including numerical data or specific figures.
Include some numerical details or figures when relevant.
Include many numerical details and precise figures.

prompts.base: Summarise the given news article in English.
prompts.anchor_only:
Summarise the given news article in English.
Match this length: about 2 sentences and roughly 34 words in total.
prompts.selective:
Summarise the given news article in English.
Match this form: write about 2 sentences, use roughly 34 words in total, use about 0.7 hedging words per 100 words, use about 0.0 first-person words per 100 words.

Write statements confidently with minimal hedging or uncertainty.
Include some numerical details or figures when relevant.
